resolution.note: adopt on a boilerplate-2026 copy: no CLAUDE.md, per-skill .claude/skills links, no extra CI; 4 new tests red on main, green now

title: krn adopt respects the receiver's layout: no CLAUDE.md where the repo forbids it, new skills mirrored into an existing .claude/skills, SHA-pinned actions in the CI it writes
body:
Source: S29 rehearsal 2026-11-16, krn adopt on a scratch clone of boilerplate-2026 main 2fb16ac (logs .krn/tmp/s29/adopt2.log, t1.log post-adopt suite, t26.log pristine suite under the pinned Node 26: 62 pass, 2 fail only from an untrusted mise config in a temp dir).
Defects on the real receiver (boilerplate tests that turned red only after adopt): (1) adopt creates CLAUDE.md -> AGENTS.md although the repo asserts CLAUDE.md is absent (tests/agents.test.mjs:41; check how it feeds Claude); (2) .claude/skills is a per-skill mirror directory, adopt adds 4 core skills to .agents/skills only ('.claude/skills mirrors .agents/skills'); (3) the ci.yml adopt writes uses actions/checkout@v4 and setup-node@v4, refused by 'every action ... pinned by a full commit SHA'; adopt also adds that CI although build.yml already runs 'mise run check' (includes the test command).
Outcome: adopting boilerplate-2026 leaves its own suite as green as before.
Proof: node --test test/adopt/adopt.test.ts: pass (fixtures for each of the three receiver layouts).
